entries.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant — Pulsed Laser Template Engineering (PLATEN)
entries.org: Center for Quantum Research and Technology (CQRT), University of Oklahoma
entries.body: Began in cleanroom semiconductor nanofabrication — photolithography, reactive ion etching and pulsed laser deposition to build and evaluate high-aspect-ratio micro- and nanostructures, tuning anisotropic plasma etch parameters (gas chemistry, RF power, chamber pressure) for vertical sidewalls and controlled feature depth. Now working on the design side in the same group, on optically bistable ring resonators.

entries.title: Electrical Systems Member
entries.body: Developed CAD layouts in Onshape for electrical component placement, wire routing and electromechanical integration, balancing signal integrity against thermal and mechanical constraints, and designed the robot’s power distribution architecture.

entries.title: Research Apprentice — Light–Matter Interaction (Dr. Tischler)
entries.org: Center for Quantum Research and Technology (CQRT), University of Oklahoma
entries.body: Conducted systematic literature reviews of quantum optical phenomena in silicon carbide and wide-bandgap semiconductor nanocrystals, building a materials-level foundation for next-generation photonics, and worked alongside the optical spectroscopy systems used to characterise them.

entries.title: Research Apprentice — Cloud Microphysics (Dr. McFarquhar)
entries.org: National Weather Center, University of Oklahoma
entries.body: Analysed high-resolution aircraft datasets from the CAESAR campaign — an NSF/NCAR C-130 flying cold-air outbreaks out of Kiruna, Sweden — to characterise how cloud microphysical properties vary with altitude. Compared water content, particle size and condensation-nuclei concentration across several probes over normalised cloud altitude, running end-to-end data processing and visualisation in Python (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib).
